recommendations: Keep the bear-search days flexible and verify current sightings and access before fixing the exact valleys or viewpoints.
Consider Quito as the operational base for the northern bear-search segment so the guide can adjust sites using current local reports.
Consider a full-day Antisana outing for Andean Condor and high-Andean wildlife before the bear-search segment.
Use Mindo as the birding base and combine Bellavista with a contrasting lower-elevation reserve rather than spending a complete day at only one site.
For additional Chocó birding, consider Mashpi Amagusa or another complementary reserve before transferring toward Cotopaxi.
Treat Cotopaxi, horse riding and Quito-area sightseeing as a separate closing segment whose routing must be confirmed.
